heading: Undocumented
lead: In this title, the term “undocumented” means not having and not required to have a certificate of documentation issued under chapter 121 of this title.

notes.text: Historical and Revision Notes RevisedSectionSource (U.S. Code)Source (Statutes at Large) 11346:2101(41). The words “certificate of documentation” are substituted for “document” for consistency with chapter 121.
